messages:
yusuf: Repro: observed ~30% p50 latency regression when qwen2p5 takes the ALiBi fallback path with our multilingual tokenizer. Happening on long CJK-heavy inputs. Attaching quick repro, need triage. cc @rachel @tom

 tom: Can you share the profiler dump and the kv cache shapes? My gut says head/kv mismatch or an extra remap memcpy.

 yusuf: Repro command I ran:
 ```
 ./run_infer --model qwen2p5 --rope-mode alibi-fallback --input tests/multilang/utf8_long.txt --profile perf.json
 ```
 Profiler top lines (sampling):
 ```
 kernel_selector.cpp:choose 42.1%
 aten::matmul 35.0%
 kv_cache::mem_copy 12.4%
 ```
 kv cache runtime log excerpt:
 ```
 [INFO] KV_CACHE SHAPE: batch=8 seq=1024 heads=32 dim_per_head=64 stored_heads=31
 [WARN] kv_index_mismatch: head_count!=stored_heads (32 != 31)
 ```

 rachel: That WARN is suspicious. Config-wise qwen2p5 should be heads=32; kv_heads=31 isn't impossible but indicates a mismatch between model metadata and runtime mapping. Multilang tokenizers often spit surrogate/boundary tokens that can change token offsets used for KV indexing.

 lena: Quick bisect: turning kernel_selector.alibi_fallback=false brings p50 down from ~160ms to ~120ms on the same load. So the fallback path adds memcpy/remap + extra cache churn. Also observed a larger number of kv evictions per-request in the fallback path.

 tom: Any stack for the remap path?

 yusuf: Stack traces:
 ```
 remap_alibi_to_rope()  // kernel_selector.cpp
 write_shards()         // kv_cache.cpp
 handle_request()       // serve_loop.cpp
 ```
 Also saw logs showing token offset arrays differ between host-tokenizer and runtime: e.g. host_offsets=[0,3,6,...], runtime_offsets=[0,2,5,...] for same raw bytes.

 rachel: Hypothesis: tokenizer/normalizer differences shift token-to-position mapping which then shifts KV indices and triggers our defensive path that remaps ALiBi->RoPE layout. That remap currently does a full shard copy and may mis-handle head packing if kv_heads != expected_kv_heads. We should add fail-fast checks that log raw token bytes + offsets for repro.

 lena: Proposed quick patch (not for prod auto-align):
 ```
 if (kv_heads != expected_kv_heads) {
   log.error("kv_heads mismatch: %d vs %d", kv_heads, expected_kv_heads);
   dump_request_payload();
   return error::InvalidConfig;
 }
 ```
 This stops silent alignment which could mask the root cause.

 tom: I agree don't auto-fix. Fail fast, capture payload, and add unit tests for multilingual token boundaries. Also add a microbenchmark for the remap code path to quantify memcpy cost.

 yusuf: Uploaded a minimized repro tarball with raw bytes + token offset arrays: s3://redwood-test/qwen2p5/rope-alibi-repro.tar.gz and created a minimal script to replay.

 ops-bot: deploy-bot: build/serve-candidate-20260308 deployed to staging (id: bc7a1f).

 rachel: Additional note: switching tokenizer to utf8-strict on the host reduced token offset divergence in my runs. That could be a temporary mitigation for customers until we fix the remap invariants.

 tom: Assigning this to yusuf + rachel. I'll open a tracking issue with regression tag + perf-hold. Please include perf.json profiler and the s3 artifact in the issue.

 yusuf: Created issue #3482 and attached perf.json + the s3 link. Starting a local bisect to narrow which kernel_selector change introduced the reg.

 lena: I'll run hardware perf counters next (L1/L2 misses, DRAM bandwidth) to see if remap path is memory-bound or compute-bound and post results in the issue.

 rachel: :thumbsup:
